hero.title: I build digital solutions that make a difference.
hero.subtitle: As a Software Engineer, I turn your ideas into robust web and mobile products, from prototype to deployment.

services.title: What I do
services.subtitle: Tailored solutions for every need, from one-off projects to long-term partnerships.

mobile_web.title: Mobile & Web expertise
mobile_web.description: Native and cross-platform apps, modern web interfaces — Kotlin, Flutter, React, Vue, TypeScript. Products built to last, from the very first screen to store release.

devops.title: DevOps & Self-Hosting
devops.description: A genuine taste for DevOps, fueled by my homelab and self-hosting experience shared on YouTube: service deployment, CI/CD pipelines and machine configuration.

projects.title: One-off projects
projects.description: A clear scope and a fast delivery: modern SEO-optimized showcase website, automation, technical migration or extra hands on a project already under way.

process.title: How I work
process.subtitle: Three steps, from our first conversation to long after going live.

consulting.title: Listening & Consulting
consulting.description: We start by understanding the real need, not just the initial request. Scoping, constraints, budget and technical trade-offs: I ask the right questions before writing a single line of code.

design_dev.title: Design & Development
design_dev.description: From idea to shipped product: architecture, technology choices, iterative development and deployment. Regular check-ins to validate the direction together, rather than months of radio silence.

support.title: Technical support
support.description: The project does not end at go-live. Fixes, new features, monitoring and knowledge transfer to your teams: you are never left alone with the code.

missions.title: Recent projects
missions.subtitle: Varied projects, modern technologies, real added value.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Passionate about technology, driven by knowledge sharing.
about.description: Software engineer based in France, I design and build custom digital solutions. My approach: understand first, code second. I invest in each project as if it were my own, with rigor and pragmatism.
about.description2: Beyond code, I share my passion for tech through my YouTube channel AyLabs — smart home, 3D printing, homelab and more.
about.aycore: A solid legal framework for a smooth collaboration — clear contracts and professional invoicing.

aylabs.subtitle: My YouTube channel
